prospective_windows.iteration_order: frozen cohort units, then counts40/60/80/100, then trial index
prospective_windows.endpoints: half-open, reset each trial to its start
prospective_windows.cross_count_draws: independent draws from the declared sequential RNG stream; no nesting
prospective_windows.source_identity_requirement: Freeze runtime/version, seed, cohort order and realized window hashes before candidate or outcome access.

sensitivity.support: Separate panel-specific shared tau-only mask: all eight condition coordinates and both30min reference taus must be finite. Both policies use identical support.
sensitivity.r_squared_and_covariates: No R-squared sign/availability or covariate exclusion in sensitivity; preserve diagnostic failures.
sensitivity.nonpositive_reference: Retain tau-available unit in denominator; suppress every affected median/percentage instead of dropping undefined errors.
sensitivity.interpretation: Conditional stability on common fit success and fixed realized windows. All original-population success/failure/retention companions are mandatory. No unconditional robustness/accuracy claim.
mandatory_companions: Per-method/per-level original-denominator tau availability and complete-fit counts
Per-method/per-level missingR2 and negativeR2 diagnostics; every failed coordinate with original reason
Original and tau-complete-case unit counts per biological mouse and area for each panel
Full original-unit eligibility and undefined-error ledger under both reference policies

figure7c.model: Gaussian random-unit-intercept linear mixed model, REML
figure7c.standardization: R scale sampleSD over the expanded four- or two-method long table
figure7c.eligibility: Unchanged Figure7C common four-method missing-fit/covariate union, then any negativeR2 exclusion. ZeroR2 retained.
figure7c.undefined_log: Keep original selected-unit ledger; withhold whole affected model on any zero/nonpositive/undefined log argument. No additional favorable row selection.
figure7c.numerical_specialization: Complete balanced methods share three predictors; fixed effects are multivariateOLS and REML covariance has common/within eigenspaces. This is not a generic GLM/LMM solver.

prospective_animal_uncertainty.primary: whole-mouse percentile bootstrap of fixed effects
prospective_animal_uncertainty.sampling: Draw G biological mice with replacement; retain all selected units/methods in each mouse, including duplicates from repeated mouse draws.
prospective_animal_uncertainty.estimand: Neuron-weighted regression coefficients under the declared model; not equal-mouse effects.
prospective_animal_uncertainty.scaling: Fixed original model-table covariate centering/scaling in every draw.
prospective_animal_uncertainty.failed_draws: Record each rank-deficient/nonfinite replicate; no redraw or silent omission. Any failed draw withholds all percentile intervals.
prospective_animal_uncertainty.conditioning: Conditional on admitted cohort, fitted taus, realized windows and original scaling; not window-resampling uncertainty.
prospective_animal_uncertainty.diagnostic: Mouse-cluster CR1 covariance with G/(G-1)*(N_long-1)/(N_long-P_fixed), no p-values or joint Wald test.
prospective_animal_uncertainty.mouse_order: First occurrence among retained source-model units, retaining the admitted cohort order
prospective_animal_uncertainty.G: Number of distinct biological mouse IDs among retained model units; original and retained counts are reported for every original mouse and area
prospective_animal_uncertainty.draw_order: Replicates0..999; within each replicate draw G mouse indices in order with replacement
prospective_animal_uncertainty.runtime_and_draw_identity: Record Python and NumPy versions and exact sampled-index sequence/hash; prospective input admission must freeze runtime, source identity and seed before outcomes.
